content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DEI Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DEI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DEI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the DEI Recruitment 2026 is 31 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the DEI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 13 vacancies are available for the posts of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, and Yoga Instructor as per the DEI notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for DEI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the DEI Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official DEI website to fill out and submit their application forms.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the DEI posts?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria for all the posts are as per NCH Norms. Detailed qualifications for each specific post are provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for DEI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 148/- (including 18% GST). This fee must be paid online during the application process.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the DEI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DEI Recruitment 2026 includes a Seminar-cum-Presentation followed by an Interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification for DEI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification for DEI Recruitment 2026 can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, where a direct link to the PDF is provided.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of Dayalbagh Educational Institute?
faq.answer: The official website of Dayalbagh Educational Institute (DEI) is https://www.dei.ac.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and to apply.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations mentioned for DEI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxations. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any applicable age relaxations.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for the DEI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for the DEI Recruitment 2026 is exclusively online. Offline applications will not be accepted.
